snippet.title: 【Trailer】The Journey into Lethe Begins!
snippet.description:
Envoy, the Journey into Lethe has just began! ✨

Take a first look at Dream and Lethe Record — a delicate realm where legendary scholars gather and forgotten destinies await.

Let Little Qilin be your guide into this ancient fantasy:

🌸 Recruit Scholars – Summon the legendary figures of Lethe
🌸 Exquisite Visuals – Art refined down to every detail
🌸 Catio Village – Cozy living with your feline companions
🌸 Destiny Awakens – Outwit fate through tactical mastery
🌸 Peach Cottage – Where soulmates meet in serendipity
🌸 Lethe Pact – Reunite with bonds from a past life

Are you ready to enter this journey?

☆━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━☆
🎐 Dream and Lethe Record - A Masterpiece of Ancient Fantasy RPG 🎐

💡 Follow the official fanpage to stay updated on all the latest from Lethe!

🔸 Pre-Register Now: https://dream.vnggames.com/en/ 
🎁 Official Webshop: http://shop.vnggames.com/game/all/dream 
✍ Official Support Channels: https://support.vnggames.com/products/dream-and-lethe-record-sea-805-4c30e9826a783967167937907b6a9bcb/problems
